name: Imagera
tagline: Generate and edit images, video, voice and music from Cline
description: Remote MCP server for image, video, voice, music and 3D generation and editing on an Imagera account (OAuth sign-in, no API key in config). Every billable tool states its credit cost, and a free estimate_cost tool returns the exact cost of a request before anything runs. Skills tools run multi-step jobs such as product photo sets, storyboards and consistent characters.
